question: What is the supreme power called at the farthest point of emission?
premises: At the far end of emission the power is called supreme kundalini.
It is also called the space of Shiva.
That is called the supreme abode of the self of Brahman.
inference: The culmination of emission is identified with supreme kundalini and the highest Shiva-space.
plain_english: At the farthest point of emission, that power is called the supreme kundalini. It is also called the space of Shiva and the supreme abode of the self of Brahman.
